title: Ada bar Chavu
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 75b: he owned a ben pekua—an animal removed alive from its slaughtered mother's womb—on which a bear fell. He came before Rav Ashi, and the passage implies that he was a Torah scholar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source has דובא, bear; the consulted Chullin paragraph has דיבא, wolf. Ben pekua denotes the animal itself, not a human son.
Hyman’s inference that Ada was a Torah scholar is retained as an inference; the consulted narrative concerns his animal and his exchange with Rav Ashi.
